implementation.note: Six standalone MCP simulation operations return a structured diagnostic for missing modules.

architecture.note: Operation registration reuses the project inventory and wraps the original simulation handler.

native_api.note: C++ editor tools use registerNativeSimulationCheck to register the schema and normal operation together.

skill.note: Native module verification recipe covers reportMissingNativeModules and skipped checks.

mcp.note: Standalone stdio test exercised each tool and discovered its argument in tools/list.

studio.note: The request targets headless operation arguments. It adds no editor panel or authored property.

inspector.note: This is a read-only simulation command option with no inspectable object.

persistence.note: Diagnostics return request-scoped JSON and write no project or simulation state.

graphs.note: The option does not operate on graph assets, nodes or expressions.

performance.note: The module inventory runs once for an opted-in check, outside the simulation tick. No hot loop changes.

platforms.note: Executed Mac standalone MCP on the host architecture. Other operating systems have no separate implementation and were not exercised.

dependencies.note: Uses the existing compiledNativeIds and missingNativeModules in the editor core. The built server exercised the combined path.

headless.note: Both the diagnostic and a deterministic one-second match were exercised without the editor GUI.

examples.note: Developer guide shows a diagnostic response, option and subsequent build lookup.

tests.note: Real stdio test covers all six tools, two absent modules, default failure, static stats, file integrity and checksum parity. Retested on the integrated Mac tree; see issues-197-202-integrated-mac.json.

handoff.note: Implementation and final runtime evidence are linked in the acceptance handoff.

documentation.note: The native modules reference documents the option, status and host requirement.

publishing.note: The change exposes a headless diagnostic with no rendered or interactive surface.
